name: bytes-payload-under-binary-codec
description: WSM-CDC-008: under a binary codec raw bytes are a first-class payload type, and they survive a round trip in both directions unchanged. Under JSON they are not a payload type at all and muxws must not base64-encode them on the application's behalf, so this fixture declares requires_codec and every runner configured with another codec skips it with a recorded reason rather than passing it silently. {"$bytes": [...]} is a placeholder the runner replaces with the byte string those values spell - it is not a payload shape and never reaches the wire; a runner that leaves it as a mapping would pass this fixture while testing nothing, so the msgpack runner must assert the substitution happened.
